units.title: Circle geometry and proofs
units.why: Geometric proof develops precise reasoning from stated theorems and given information.
principles: angle at centre is twice angle at circumference on same arc
tangent is perpendicular to radius at contact
examples: A centre angle 80° subtends circumference angle 40°
misconceptions: using a theorem without matching its diagram conditions
practice: Write a reason for supplementary cyclic angles.
Explain why diagrams need given labels.
solutions: line joining two points on circle

videoPackage.title: Proof from circle theorems
videoPackage.transcript: We match each diagram condition to a named theorem and write a reason beside every conclusion.
